summary: IRGC Navy fired two anti-ship cruise missiles at commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, signaling an offensive posture amid US-Iran talks at UNGA. US and Iranian officials held three hours of negotiations, with Tehran demanding an end to naval blockade and release of frozen assets. Houthi attacks forced the closure of Riyadh International Airport, while Israeli strikes in Gaza and artillery shelling in Lebanon continued.
key_points: IRGC Navy launched two anti-ship cruise missiles at unauthorized commercial ships in Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @kianmeli1/92378)
US and Iranian delegations held three-hour talks at UNGA; Witkoff and Araghchi discussed reopening Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @mamlekate/104589, @naya_foriraq/91317, @shin_persian/10352)
Turkish Airlines, AnadoluJet, Pegasus suspended all Iran flights until March 2027; Iraq also banned Iranian carriers. (Source: @kianmeli1/92370, @shin_persian/10345, @mamlekate/104578)
Houthi attacks halted operations at Riyadh International Airport. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91318, @naya_foriraq/91309)
Israeli strike in Mawasi, Khan Yunis killed one and wounded several. (Source: @N12chat/226609)
Artillery shelling reported in Meiss el-Jabal and Al-Mansouri, Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/44464, @redlinkleb/44422)
IDF declared "Turkish Horseman" procedure in Jordan Valley over suspected infiltration. (Source: @pkpoi/144041)
Iran restored half of Pars gas field production after Israeli attack. (Source: @asafroz/53698)

sections.executive_summary: IRGC Navy fired two anti-ship cruise missiles at commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, signaling an offensive posture amid US-Iran talks at UNGA. US and Iranian officials held three hours of negotiations, with Tehran demanding an end to naval blockade and release of frozen assets. Houthi attacks forced the closure of Riyadh International Airport, while Israeli strikes in Gaza and artillery shelling in Lebanon continued.

points: IRGC Navy fired two anti-ship cruise missiles at two commercial ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz without Iranian authorization, demonstrating an offensive posture amid ongoing US-Iran negotiations in New York. (Source: @kianmeli1/92378, @kianmeli1/92376)

US officials engaged in three hours of direct talks with an Iranian delegation at UNGA sidelines; Special Envoy Steve Witkoff confirmed lengthy mediated discussions, while FM Araghchi presented Tehran's terms for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, including immediate end to naval blockade and release of all frozen assets. (Source: @mamlekate/104589, @naya_foriraq/91317, @shin_persian/10352)

Iranian Armed Forces condemned Trump's threats to destroy the Islamic Republic, pledging a "more crushing and unpredictable response"; Gen. Rahim Safavi asserted the US cannot reopen the Strait of Hormuz by military pressure alone. (Source: @presstv/207850, @presstv/207855, @rodast_omiddana/81305)
Iran officially announced restoration of half the production capacity at the Pars gas field, which was damaged by Israeli strikes during the war. (Source: @asafroz/53698)
Multiple explosions heard in Tabriz, possibly seven to eight blasts, attributed by locals to fireworks for Sacred Defense Week celebrations. (Source: @mamlekate/104588)

Turkish Airlines, AnadoluJet, and Pegasus Airlines suspended all flights to and from Iran until March 2027 due to new US sanctions; Iraq simultaneously enforced a ban on Iranian airlines. (Source: @kianmeli1/92370, @shin_persian/10345, @mamlekate/104578)
Israeli strike on a vehicle in Mawasi, Khan Yunis, killed one Palestinian and wounded several others, according to Gaza reports. (Source: @N12chat/226609)

IDF declared "Turkish Horseman" emergency procedure in the Jordan Valley sector following a suspected certain infiltration into Israeli territory, deploying forces to the area. (Source: @pkpoi/144041)

Netanyahu scheduled a pre-trip security consultation with Defense Minister and senior officials ahead of his US visit, amid Channel 15 reports of potential "cutlet" (interruption) during his UN speech. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81299)
A bus caught fire on Route 60 between Tapuach Junction and Rehelim in Samaria, closing the highway in both directions; police and firefighters responded. (Source: @yediotnews25/135232)
Approximately 14 activists from the "Halutzei HaBashan" group crossed into Syrian territory and were detained; all were en route back to Israel. (Source: @New_security8200/203891)
Reports of hostile warplanes flying over northern occupied Palestine (likely northern Israel) again. (Source: @redlinkleb/44488)
Israeli strike in Mawasi, Khan Yunis, resulted in one fatality and multiple injuries; the attack targeted a vehicle in the designated humanitarian zone. (Source: @N12chat/226609)
Bus fire on Route 60 in Samaria (West Bank) caused full closure of the highway between Tapuach Junction and Rehelim; emergency services on scene. (Source: @yediotnews25/135232)
French President Macron at UNGA stated the "apparent peace in Gaza did not bring humanitarian corridors," calling it a spectacle that shames everyone. (Source: @yediotnews25/135229)
IDF infiltration alert in Jordan Valley ("Turkish Horseman" procedure) indicates ongoing security tensions along the eastern border. (Source: @pkpoi/144041)
Live map indicates artillery shelling targeting Meiss el-Jabal in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/44464)
Live map indicates artillery shelling targeting Al-Mansouri in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/44422)
Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa met Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaydi on UNGA sidelines for the first time, discussing bilateral relations and regional stability. (Source: @SharghDaily/185270)

Al-Sharaa stated the Golan Heights belongs to its residents and is Syrian territory per UN recognition; he criticized Israeli policy, noting even the presidential palace and airports were bombed. (Source: @asafroz/53689)
